info.name: retailcloud Catalog Service API - CRUD Tests
info.description:
Auto-generated from the rc-catalog-service-v3 OpenAPI spec (v1.0.0). Covers full CRUD flows (Create / List / Get / Replace (PUT) / Update (PATCH) / Delete-or-Deactivate) for every writable catalog resource, plus read-only requests for the reference-only Country master.

How to use:
1. Set the `base_url` collection variable (Local: http://localhost:8080, Dev: https://dev-platform.rc.fyi).
2. Set the `access_token` collection variable to a valid Bearer token (all endpoints require auth; the catalog is merchant-sharded via the token's `domain` claim).
3. Run a resource's folder top-to-bottom (Create runs first and captures the new record's id into a collection variable, e.g. {{allergen_id}}, which the List/Get/Replace/Update/Delete requests in that folder reuse automatically).
4. Resources with a parent (Subcollection needs a Collection; Menu Page needs a Menu) are ordered so the parent folder's Create runs before the child folder.
5. Most resources have no hard-delete endpoint — the API instead deactivates a record via PATCH {status: INACTIVE} (or DISCONTINUED for Item). Only Subcollection and Menu Page expose a true DELETE.

Tip: use Postman's Collection Runner on an individual folder to exercise a full CRUD lifecycle for that resource in one click.
